main_text.p: Capitis igitur quarti parte secunda narratur initiù prædicationis Christi in synagogis Galilææ (v. 14.15.) & nominatim sermo habitus Nazareth ex propheta Iesaia, usque ad v. 13. Tertia narratur ejectio dæmonij muti in Synagoga Capernaum, usque ad v. 38. Quarta sanatio socrus Petri, v. 38.39. & multorum ægrotorum & dæmoniacorum, v. 40. & 41. Postrema continuatio prædicationis in Galilæa.

Capitis quinti partes sunt principales tres: Prima narrantur aliquot miracula Christi : ut est 1. captura piscium. 11 mundatio leprosi. v. 12. 111 Sanatio paralytici, v. 17. Secunda narratur vocatio Leuis, id est, Matthæi, v. 27. 28. Tertia narratur defensio contra Scribarum & Pharisæorum reprehensionem primam, propter conuersationem Christi cum publicanis, usque ad v. 33. & secundam propter indulgentiam eius erga discipulos.

Capitis sexti membra tria sunt. 1 Christus defendit discipulos contra criminationem Pharisæorum de violato, propter euulsas spicas, Sabbatho, usque ad v. 6. 11. Sanat manum cuiusdam aridam, seque contra tacitam Pharisæorum criminationem de Sabbatho violato inde natam defendit: usque ad v. 12. 111. Eligit duodecim Apostolos: & sermonem prolixum habet, tum ad discipulos recens electos contra persecutiones consolandos, tum ad turbam reliquam a v. 24. usque ad finem capitis.

Cap. septimo narrantur Christi primo quidem gesta, nimirum miraculum sanati servi centurionis, usque ad v. 11. & excitati a morte filij viduæ Naitanæ, usque ad v. 18. Deinde dicta, videlicet Responsum datum nuncijs missis à Iohanne Bapti-

page.notes: Left edge shows part of the facing page (show-through and neighbouring page edge), not transcribed. Doubtful: "Naitana" as printed (Nain is meant; kept as printed). The "Z" in Nazareth and the "Responsum" line are set in a swash or unclear type and were read with some uncertainty. A small mark in the right margin near the last line is a stain, not a note. No catchword is printed.
